A '''Cathar''' served as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|Great Hunt]]. He accompanied [[Shaela Nuur]], [[Duron Qel-Droma]], and [[Guun Han Saresh]] during the [[Cleansing of Tatooine]]. During the cleansing, he was killed by a [[Terentatek/Legends|Terentatek]]. His body was then taken back to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].
